name: SAP ABAP
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - Back-End Developer - ABAP Cloud (C_ABAPD)
SAP Certified Development Associate - ABAP with SAP NetWeaver
SAP Certified Associate - SAP Fiori Application Developer
tools: SAP S/4HANA or BTP ABAP environment trial

beginner.summary: For new SAP developers with some programming background. Covers the ABAP language, data types, internal tables, database access with ABAP SQL, modularisation, object-oriented ABAP, the data dictionary, classic reports and ALV, debugging and transports, ending with a working report application.
prerequisites: Knows basic programming ideas such as variables, loops and functions
Basic SQL helps but is not required
Access to an ABAP system or the BTP ABAP environment trial
outcomes: Write, activate and debug ABAP programs and classes
Read and change database data with ABAP SQL safely
Build reports with selection screens and ALV output
Move developments through the landscape with transports

days.topic: ABAP Setup, Development Tools and First Program
subtopics: What ABAP is used for in SAP systems
Installing ABAP Development Tools in Eclipse
Connecting to a system and creating a package
Creating a class with the console runner
The SAP GUI editor SE38 and SE80
days.lab_task: Install ADT, connect to the training system, create a package and a class that prints a formatted receipt to the console, and write the same as a classic report in SE38.
days.deliverable: Package, class, report and console output
checks: Run the class with F9 in ADT
Introduce a syntax error and activate
Activation fails with the line and message

days.topic: Data Types, Variables and Expressions
subtopics: Elementary types: i, p, decfloat34, c, string, d, t
days.lab_task: Write a payroll calculator class that computes gross and net pay with packed numbers, formats results with string templates and calculates the days until the next pay date.
days.deliverable: Class source and console output for three employees
checks: Result rounded to two decimals correctly
Compute days to the next pay date
Assign a string with letters to a numeric field

days.topic: Control Structures and Conditions
days.lab_task: Write a shipping cost class that applies rules by country, weight and customer group using COND and SWITCH, and print costs for a table of ten test cases.
days.deliverable: Class source and results for ten test cases
checks: All costs match the rule table
Rewrite a nested IF as COND

days.topic: Internal Tables: Standard, Sorted and Hashed
days.lab_task: Load 10,000 sales lines into standard, sorted and hashed tables, compare lookup times by key, and produce totals per customer without duplicates.
days.deliverable: Program source and a timing comparison
checks: Look up 10,000 keys in each table type
Hashed is fastest, standard is slowest
Read a key that does not exist with a table expression
objectives: Choose table types by access pattern

days.topic: ABAP Dictionary: Tables, Data Elements and Domains
days.lab_task: Create a custom table for training courses with domains, data elements, a foreign key to a check table and a search help, then fill it with test data.
days.deliverable: Dictionary objects and the filled table
checks: Enter a course with an invalid category
Table is adjusted and existing data kept

days.topic: Reading Data with ABAP SQL
subtopics: WHERE, ORDER BY and UP TO
FOR ALL ENTRIES and its risks
days.lab_task: Write ABAP SQL to list flights with carrier names, total bookings per connection and the five busiest routes, using joins and aggregates instead of loops.
days.deliverable: Class with queries and results
checks: Select a key that does not exist
Replace a nested SELECT in a loop with a join

days.topic: Changing Data: INSERT, UPDATE, MODIFY and DELETE
days.lab_task: Write a booking class that locks a flight, checks free seats, inserts a booking and updates the seat count in one logical unit of work, rolling back on failure.
days.deliverable: Class source and test results
checks: Book the last seat from two sessions
Second session is stopped by the lock
Delete bookings older than a date

days.topic: Modularisation: Methods, Function Modules and Includes
subtopics: Methods with importing, exporting and returning
days.lab_task: Refactor the booking logic into small methods, wrap one in a function module, call it remotely from another system and compare the approaches.
days.deliverable: Refactored class, function module and RFC call result
checks: Call the function module from SE37 test
Call it as RFC from another client

days.topic: Object-Oriented ABAP: Classes and Objects
days.lab_task: Model customers, accounts and transactions as classes with constructors that validate input and methods that update balances, and run a test scenario.
days.deliverable: Global classes and scenario output
checks: Create an account with a negative opening balance
Access a private attribute from outside

days.topic: Inheritance, Interfaces and Polymorphism
days.lab_task: Build a payroll class hierarchy with salaried and hourly employees and an interface for payable items, and process all of them in one loop.
days.deliverable: Classes, interface and output
checks: Process one of each employee type
Each pay amount follows its rule
No change to the processing loop

days.topic: Exception Handling with Class-Based Exceptions
days.lab_task: Add a custom exception class to the booking class for full flights, raise it with message text, catch it in the caller and chain a database exception as the previous one.
days.deliverable: Exception class, updated code and output
checks: Custom exception is raised with the flight number in the text

days.topic: Classic Reports: Selection Screens and Events
subtopics: Report events: INITIALIZATION, AT SELECTION-SCREEN, START-OF-SELECTION
days.lab_task: Write a report that lists sales orders by date range and customer with input checks, a saved variant and messages, and run it in the background.
days.deliverable: Report source, variant and background job output
checks: Enter an end date before the start date
Error message on the selection screen

days.topic: ALV Output with SALV
days.lab_task: Show the sales order report in SALV with totals per customer, a hotspot that opens the order, user layouts and export to Excel.
days.deliverable: Report with ALV output and exported file

days.topic: Debugging and Runtime Analysis
subtopics: The ABAP debugger in ADT and SAP GUI
days.lab_task: Find and fix five planted bugs in a provided report using breakpoints and watchpoints, analyse one short dump in ST22 and find a slow query with ST05.
days.deliverable: Bug log, fixes and trace evidence
checks: Set a watchpoint on a variable
Debugger stops when the value changes
Find the slow query in ST05

days.topic: Function Modules and BAPIs for Business Data
subtopics: When to use APIs instead of BAPIs
days.lab_task: Create sales orders from a file using BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2, commit them, collect messages from the RETURN table and report failures.
days.deliverable: Program source and results log
checks: Include a line with a bad material
Error from RETURN is reported and the order is not created
Explain why no orders are saved

days.topic: Working with Files and Background Jobs
subtopics: Reading and writing application server files
days.lab_task: Build a job that reads a CSV from the application server, validates rows, posts valid ones through a BAPI, writes errors to the application log and runs nightly.
days.deliverable: Program, job definition and application log
checks: Run the job with a file containing bad rows
Good rows posted and errors in SLG1
Job finished with the log attached
Point it to a missing file
Job ends with a clear error

days.topic: Forms and Output: Smart Forms and Adobe Forms
days.lab_task: Create an Adobe form for a course certificate, fill it from a custom table in ABAP, preview it and email it as a PDF.
days.deliverable: Form, calling program and sample PDF
checks: Participant data appears in the layout
Run for a participant without a name

days.topic: Transports, Packages and Code Quality
days.lab_task: Run ATC on the course code, fix the findings, compare two versions of a class, and release a transport to the quality system.
days.deliverable: ATC results before and after, version comparison and transport log

days.topic: First ABAP CDS Views
subtopics: Using CDS views in ABAP SQL
days.lab_task: Create CDS view entities for flights with associations to carriers and bookings, add annotations and read them from an ABAP class.
days.deliverable: CDS views and class output
checks: Follow the association in a query
Add a parameter for a date
Only flights from that date are returned

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Course Booking Report Application
days.lab_task: Build a course booking application with custom tables, classes for booking rules and exceptions, locking, an ALV report with selection screen, a nightly job that sends reminders and clean ATC results, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Package, transport, ATC result and a 10-minute demo
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application

intermediate.summary: For ABAP developers who write classic reports and classes. Covers modern ABAP syntax, ABAP on HANA with CDS and AMDP, the RESTful ABAP Programming Model, OData services and Fiori elements, enhancements, ABAP Unit, integration with RFC and IDocs, and performance.
prerequisites: Writes ABAP classes, reports and ABAP SQL
Knows the data dictionary and debugging
Has used transports in a project
outcomes: Write modern ABAP and push logic to SAP HANA
Build transactional Fiori apps with RAP
Extend standard SAP safely with enhancements and BAdIs
Test, integrate and tune ABAP applications

days.topic: Modern ABAP: Constructor Expressions and Table Comprehensions
days.lab_task: Rewrite a provided 300-line classic report into modern ABAP using constructor expressions, REDUCE, FILTER and FOR, keeping identical output.
days.deliverable: Rewritten code and output comparison

days.topic: ABAP SQL on HANA: Expressions, Window Functions and CTEs
subtopics: SQL expressions and functions in ABAP SQL
days.lab_task: Replace loop-based processing in a sales analysis report with ABAP SQL using CASE, window functions and CTEs, and measure the runtime gain.
days.deliverable: Rewritten queries and timing comparison
checks: Rank customers by revenue with a window function
SQL version at least five times faster
One database call instead of many

days.topic: Advanced CDS Views: Hierarchies, Annotations and Access Control
days.lab_task: Build a CDS stack for sales analytics with a basic, composite and consumption view, an access control that limits users to their sales organisation and analytical annotations.
days.deliverable: CDS views, access control and test results
checks: Preview as a user for one sales organisation
All rows appear, confirming the rule worked

days.topic: ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP)
subtopics: Using AMDP in CDS table functions
days.lab_task: Write an AMDP that calculates customer lifetime value with SQLScript, expose it as a CDS table function and compare its runtime with an ABAP implementation.
days.deliverable: AMDP class, table function and timing comparison
checks: AMDP faster on the full data set

days.topic: RESTful ABAP Programming Model: Managed Business Objects
days.lab_task: Build a managed RAP business object for travel requests with early numbering, a validation for dates, a determination for the status and an approve action.
days.deliverable: RAP business object and service binding
checks: Create a travel request with the end date before the start
Status is set by the determination

days.topic: RAP with Draft, Feature Control and Authorisation
days.lab_task: Add draft handling, make fields read-only after approval, hide the approve action for approved requests and restrict changes to the requester's own trips.
days.deliverable: Updated behaviour definition and implementation
checks: Leave a draft and come back
Fields are read-only and the action is hidden

days.topic: Fiori Elements Apps on RAP Services
subtopics: Generating an app with Fiori tools
days.lab_task: Generate a Fiori elements app for the travel service, add metadata extensions for columns, facets and value helps, deploy it to the ABAP repository and add a launchpad tile.
days.deliverable: Fiori app, metadata extensions and tile
checks: Open the app from the launchpad
objectives: Build Fiori elements apps on RAP

days.topic: OData Services: SEGW and RAP Compared
subtopics: OData concepts: entity sets, navigation, query options
RAP services as the modern approach
days.lab_task: Build a small OData V2 service in SEGW for courses, test CRUD and $expand in the Gateway client and compare it with the RAP service for effort and features.
days.deliverable: SEGW service, test results and comparison
checks: Create a course through the Gateway client

days.topic: Enhancements: User Exits, BAdIs and Enhancement Points
days.lab_task: Find and implement a BAdI that validates sales orders, add a filter by sales organisation and document why a modification was not needed.
days.deliverable: BAdI implementation, test results and documentation
checks: Save a sales order that breaks the rule
Implementation stops it with a message
Save one for another sales organisation
Rule does not apply because of the filter
Search path and reasons are recorded

days.topic: Unit Testing with ABAP Unit and Test Doubles
days.lab_task: Write ABAP Unit tests for the booking rules with a test double for the database and the CDS test double framework for a view, and reach 80 percent coverage.
days.deliverable: Test classes and coverage report
objectives: Isolate the database with test doubles

days.topic: Integration: RFC, IDocs and Web Services
subtopics: Calling REST APIs from ABAP with HTTP client
days.lab_task: Send material master changes as IDocs, process an inbound order IDoc with a custom function, reprocess a failed IDoc and call an external REST API from ABAP.
days.deliverable: IDoc configuration, function code and API call output
checks: Outbound IDoc is created with status 03
Process a failed inbound IDoc after fixing data
Response parsed into an ABAP structure

days.topic: Performance Optimisation for ABAP Programs
days.lab_task: Profile a slow provided report with SAT and ST05, fix the three biggest problems and show the runtime improvement.
days.deliverable: Profiles before and after and the fixes
checks: Find the top problem in SAT

days.topic: Authorisation Checks and Secure ABAP Coding
days.lab_task: Add a custom authorisation object to the booking app, fix a planted SQL injection in dynamic SQL and run the vulnerability analyser until no high findings remain.
days.deliverable: Authorisation object, fixes and analyser results
checks: Run the app without the authorisation
Send an injection string to the search
Treated as text after the fix

days.topic: Background Processing, Parallel Processing and Application Jobs
days.lab_task: Turn a long data correction into an application job that processes 1 million records in parallel packages, collects errors and finishes faster than the serial version.
days.deliverable: Job catalogue entry, program and timing comparison
checks: Other packages complete and the failure is logged
Schedule the application job from Fiori

days.topic: Messages, Logging and Error Handling in Applications
days.lab_task: Introduce a message class and application log for the travel app, show field-level RAP messages in Fiori and log background processing with context for support.
days.deliverable: Message class, logging code and screenshots
checks: Enter an invalid value in Fiori
Run the background job with errors
objectives: Design messages for users and support

days.topic: Working with S/4HANA Released APIs and Business Objects
subtopics: Released objects and the API state
EML: reading and modifying business objects
Calling SAP business objects from custom code
days.lab_task: Replace direct table updates in custom code with EML calls to a released business object interface, and use ATC to confirm only released objects are used.
days.deliverable: Refactored code and ATC result
checks: Run ATC with the cloud readiness check
Break a standard validation in input

days.topic: Change Documents, Number Ranges and Audit Trails
subtopics: Writing change documents from custom code
Change history in RAP and Fiori
days.lab_task: Add a number range object and change documents to the course booking tables, show the history of a booking in a Fiori facet and check the numbers stay unique under parallel bookings.
days.deliverable: Number range and change document objects, history facet and test results
checks: Change document shows old value, new value, user and time
Read changes for a date range
objectives: Use number ranges in custom code

days.topic: Flexible Workflow and SAP Business Workflow for Developers
subtopics: Choosing workflow or BTP process automation
days.lab_task: Set up a flexible workflow for purchase requests with an amount-based condition and agent determination, start it from the RAP approve flow and trace a stuck item in the workflow log.
days.deliverable: Workflow configuration, agent rule and log analysis
checks: Submit a request above the limit
Workflow item arrives in the manager's My Inbox
Approved automatically without a workflow item
Cause found in the workflow log

days.topic: abapGit and Version Control for ABAP
days.lab_task: Put the course package into a Git repository with abapGit, make a change on a branch, review it in a pull request and pull it into a second system.
days.deliverable: Repository, pull request and second system import
checks: Objects appear as files in Git

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Transactional Fiori App with RAP
subtopics: RAP business object with draft and authorisation
days.lab_task: Build a purchase request app with a RAP business object, draft, validations, actions, authorisation, a Fiori elements UI, EML calls to create the standard purchase requisition, ABAP Unit tests and clean ATC results, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, transport, test and ATC results and a 15-minute demo
checks: Standard purchase requisition is created through EML
All tests pass with coverage reported
Run ATC with cloud readiness checks
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one app
Prove quality with tests and checks

advanced.summary: For senior ABAP developers and technical architects. Covers ABAP Cloud and the clean core tier model, advanced RAP, events and extensibility, custom code migration to S/4HANA, deep HANA performance work, ABAP architecture and design patterns, DevOps for ABAP, security, AI for ABAP and technical leadership.
prerequisites: Has built RAP applications and CDS models
Has worked on an S/4HANA project
outcomes: Design clean-core ABAP solutions with ABAP Cloud
Lead custom code migration and performance work
Build event-driven and extensible ABAP applications
Run ABAP delivery with CI, quality gates and security

days.topic: ABAP Cloud and the Clean Core Tier Model
subtopics: ABAP Cloud language version and rules
days.lab_task: Classify 20 custom objects by tier, build a tier 2 wrapper for an unreleased function, use it from tier 1 code and set up ATC rules that block new tier 3 code.
days.deliverable: Classification, wrapper, tier 1 code and ATC configuration
checks: Call the unreleased function from tier 1 code directly
Call the wrapper from tier 1 code
Add new classic code in a governed package
objectives: Apply the ABAP Cloud tier model

days.topic: Advanced RAP: Unmanaged Scenarios and Legacy Integration
subtopics: Wrapping legacy BAPIs and function modules
days.lab_task: Build an unmanaged RAP business object on top of a legacy BAPI for orders, with late numbering, a transactional buffer and correct error handling in the save sequence.
days.deliverable: RAP object, buffer class and tests
checks: Create an order through the Fiori app
Number assigned at save by the BAPI
Make the BAPI fail at save

days.topic: RAP Business Events and Event-Driven ABAP
subtopics: Sending events to SAP Event Mesh
days.lab_task: Raise an event when a purchase request is approved, consume it locally to send a notification and remotely through Event Mesh in a BTP service.
days.deliverable: Event definitions, handlers and monitoring evidence

days.topic: Extensibility in S/4HANA: Cloud BAdIs, Custom Fields and Developer Extensibility
subtopics: Key user and developer extensibility together
days.lab_task: Extend a standard RAP business object with a custom field, a validation through a cloud BAdI and an extended CDS view, and prove the extension survives a simulated upgrade check.
days.deliverable: Extensions and upgrade check results
checks: Create a document with the custom field
Field saved and shown in the app

days.topic: Custom Code Migration to S/4HANA at Scale
subtopics: Remote ATC checks from a central system
days.lab_task: Run remote ATC checks on a provided custom code base, decommission unused objects, apply mass quick fixes and produce a migration plan with effort estimates.
days.deliverable: Check results, decommission list, fix log and migration plan
checks: Findings grouped by type and priority
Effort per finding type with assumptions
objectives: Use usage data and quick fixes

days.topic: Deep Performance Tuning on SAP HANA
subtopics: Plan visualiser for ABAP SQL and CDS
days.lab_task: Analyse a slow CDS-based analytical app with the plan visualiser, fix join cardinality and filter push-down problems and show the effect at 50 million rows.
days.deliverable: Plans before and after, fixes and timings
checks: Statement no longer in the top list
objectives: Tune CDS and SQL on HANA

days.topic: ABAP Design Patterns and Architecture
days.lab_task: Restructure a monolithic pricing program into layers with a factory, strategies for pricing rules, a facade over SAP APIs and package interfaces that enforce boundaries.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, package interfaces and tests
checks: Only a new strategy class is added
Use a class across a package boundary without the interface
Run the tests with injected doubles

days.topic: Advanced Testing: Integration Tests, Mocks and Test Automation
days.lab_task: Build integration tests for the purchase request app that mock EML calls to standard objects, cover the save sequence and add a UI test run in the pipeline.
days.deliverable: Test suites and pipeline results
checks: Mock the standard object to fail
Test confirms the request is not saved
Run all tests in the pipeline

days.topic: DevOps for ABAP: CI, Quality Gates and gCTS
subtopics: CI pipelines for ABAP with Project Piper
ATC and ABAP Unit as gates
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that runs ATC and ABAP Unit on every change, blocks merges on failures and moves approved changes through gCTS to the quality system.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, gate configuration and release record
checks: Push code with an ATC priority 1 finding

days.topic: Secure ABAP Development at Scale
subtopics: Secure handling of RFC and HTTP
Protecting personal data in custom code
days.lab_task: Threat-model the purchase request app, fix the top risks, add read access logging for salary fields and add vulnerability scanning to the pipeline.
days.deliverable: Threat model, fixes, logging set-up and pipeline gate

days.topic: ABAP for Analytics: Analytical CDS Queries and Embedded Analytics
subtopics: Exposing queries to SAP Analytics Cloud
days.lab_task: Build an analytical model for purchasing spend with cube, dimensions, hierarchy, currency conversion and restricted measures and consume it in an Analytics Cloud story.
days.deliverable: Analytical CDS model and story
checks: Compare totals with the source data
Totals match in the reporting currency
Values add up at each level
Spend by category and supplier shown
objectives: Expose analytics to SAP Analytics Cloud

days.topic: Generative AI and Joule for ABAP Developers
subtopics: Joule for ABAP code generation and explanation
ABAP AI SDK and the generative AI hub
Calling AI services from ABAP Cloud
days.lab_task: Use Joule to explain and write tests for a legacy class, review the output, and build a RAP action that summarises a purchase request with the generative AI hub from ABAP Cloud.
days.deliverable: Reviewed tests, RAP action and review notes
checks: Pass after review fixes, with changes recorded
objectives: Use AI tools in ABAP development

days.topic: Memory Management and Large Data Volume Processing
subtopics: ABAP memory areas: roll, extended and heap memory
SELECT with PACKAGE SIZE and cursors
Limits in background and dialog processes
days.lab_task: Fix a report that runs out of memory on 20 million rows by processing in packages with a cursor and field symbols, and compare memory use with the Memory Inspector.
days.deliverable: Fixed report and memory comparison
checks: Run the original on the full data
Runtime error for lack of memory is reproduced
Completes with peak memory under the limit
Compare a LOOP INTO with a LOOP ASSIGNING

days.topic: Migrating Classic Technologies: Dynpros, BOPF and SEGW to RAP
days.lab_task: Migrate a provided BOPF-based object and its SEGW service to RAP, reuse the business logic and plan the retirement of the old dynpro transaction.
days.deliverable: RAP object, comparison of behaviour and retirement plan
checks: Run the same test cases on old and new
All old transaction functions are covered
Users, training and switch-off date defined

days.topic: ABAP in the SAP BTP ABAP Environment and Side-by-Side
subtopics: Choosing ABAP or CAP on BTP
days.lab_task: Build a side-by-side ABAP app on BTP that reads S/4HANA purchase orders through a communication arrangement and writes approvals back, and compare effort with an on-stack version.
days.deliverable: BTP ABAP app, communication set-up and comparison
checks: Data shown in the BTP app

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production ABAP Issues
days.lab_task: Resolve four injected production problems (a dump, a failed update, a stuck lock and a memory problem), apply an SAP note correction and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Root cause found from ST22 and code
Note applied and the problem fixed
Write a runbook for update failures

days.topic: Code Reviews, Clean ABAP and Technical Debt
days.lab_task: Review three provided pull requests against a clean ABAP checklist, refactor the worst one with tests protecting behaviour and write a team standards page.
days.deliverable: Review comments, refactored code and standards page
checks: Covers naming, tests and review rules

days.topic: Technical Architecture for S/4HANA Custom Development
days.lab_task: Write the custom development architecture for a provided S/4HANA programme: where code lives by tier, reuse, integration and guidelines, and defend it to a mock architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, decision records and presentation
checks: Every case maps to a tier or BTP

days.topic: Mentoring and Leading ABAP Teams
days.lab_task: Build a skills matrix and a six-month plan to move a classic ABAP team to RAP and ABAP Cloud, estimate a provided backlog and define quality metrics.
days.deliverable: Skills matrix, team plan, estimates and metrics
checks: Measurable and tied to quality goals

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Clean-Core Extension Programme
subtopics: RAP applications with events and extensions
days.lab_task: Deliver a clean-core programme for a provided system: classify and migrate custom code, build a RAP extension with events and cloud BAdIs, tune performance, add CI and security gates and an AI feature, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Repositories, migration results, pipeline, test reports and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Run ATC with clean core rules
No new tier 3 code and findings reduced against the baseline
All gates pass for the extension
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
